latest.description: Spot bitcoin funds took in $337.56 million on Aug. 24, extending an unbroken run of inflows that has now put real money behind a rally that started with a short squeeze.

latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $338M as six-day inflow streak hits $2.26B
latest.description: Bitcoin ETFs have drawn $2.26 billion over six trading days, while year-to-date net outflows have narrowed to about $2.57 billion.

latest.title: Treasury’s bond buyback plan fights the market and heightens the danger, billionaire Druckenmiller says
latest.description: The billionaire investor argues the intervention removes a vital check on government borrowing and fiscal accountability while markets remain the better judge of prices.

latest.title: New Delhi draws in $73 billion in 11 weeks, powered by special deposits for non-resident Indians
latest.description: India has attracted inflows of $73 billion in 11 weeks, driven mostly by foreign currency bank deposits made by non-resident Indians.

latest.title: Monad proposes wallet upgrade that could survive lost keys and quantum attacks
latest.description: The Ethereum-compatible blockchain wants users to be able to replace the keys controlling an account without changing its address, opening the door to passkeys, recovery tools and post-quantum security.

latest.title: Crypto rally spills into dog and cat memecoins as smaller tokens double in a week
